note: Images under images/ are fetched locally for critic QA and are gitignored. Do not redistribute commercial game screenshots.

refs.title: USER REF — alpine groom / dense forest / long shadows
refs.lookFor: Dense evergreen forest, distant peaks with haze, corduroy groom with LONG sun shadows, course banners, vivid rider silhouette

refs.title: USER REF — race tunnel / banners / blue line
refs.lookFor: Authored race corridor, tunnel/arch, banners, line paint, packed trees on berms

refs.title: USER REF — SSX-style chase + HUD
refs.lookFor: Chase energy, dense props/lifts, HUD (time/speed/map), trick callout, readable mountain

refs.title: SSX 3 — race chase cam
refs.lookFor: Readable downhill line, dense mountain features, rider lower-third, HUD present, snow with tonal range, trees planted on slope
refs.source: Wikipedia enwiki fair-use screenshot (local critic QA only)

refs.title: Steep — open mountain freeride
refs.lookFor: Vast continuous mountain, aerial depth, off-piste powder reading as terrain not void, strong sun/sky contrast
refs.source: Wikipedia enwiki fair-use screenshot (local critic QA only)

refs.title: Riders Republic — mountain playground
refs.lookFor: Busy readable course density, landmarks, mountain silhouette, marketing-screenshot energy
refs.source: Wikipedia enwiki fair-use screenshot (local critic QA only)
refs.manualDrop: Drop a Riders Republic gameplay still here if desired (Wikipedia filename varies).

refs.title: Real powder tree run
refs.lookFor: Powder volume, trees rooted in snow, depth cues, non-flat albedo

refs.title: Real snowboarder air silhouette
refs.lookFor: Clear rider/board silhouette vs snow/sky, readable gear contrast, dynamic pose
refs.source: Wikimedia Commons — Snowboarder in flight (Tannheim, Austria).jpg

refs.title: Youth Olympics slopestyle — course line
refs.lookFor: Intentional feature spacing, readable upcoming landing, mountain context behind course
refs.source: Wikimedia Commons — 2020 Winter Youth Olympics men's slopestyle (Martin Rulsch)

refs.title: Terrain park after jump
refs.lookFor: Groomed vs soft snow contrast, feature scale vs rider, contact with snow
refs.source: Wikimedia Commons — Thunder Ridge Ski Area Terrain Park 14.jpg
